```{r warning=FALSE}
# Interpolation as an actual functions
interpolate_split_data = function(data,
                                  split_column = 'Replicates',
                                  num_points = 100,
                                  new_col_prefix = 'interpol_') {
  temp_inter_df = NULL
  interpolated_df_list = list()
  # Split data by replicates
  split_dfs = data %>% split(.[[split_column]])
  
  # All split dfs have the same concentration values, so I can choose any of them
  original_conc_vec = split_dfs[[1]]$Conc.
  
  min_concentration = min(data$Conc.)
  max_concentation = max(data$Conc.)

  log_new_concs = seq(log10(min_concentration),
                      log10(max_concentation),
                      length.out = num_points)
  
  inter_conc_vals = 10 ^ log_new_concs
  
  # Interpolate and fit a smoothing spline within each split data frame
  interpolated_dfs = lapply(split_dfs, function(df) {
    fluorescence_cols = df %>% select(starts_with('dAb'))
    for (col in fluorescence_cols) {
      spline_mod = smooth.spline(x = original_conc_vec, y = col, df = 3, spar=0.8) # Only consistently works when cv = T
      spline_preds = predict(object = spline_mod, x = inter_conc_vals)
      fitted_inter_vals = spline_preds$y
      new_col_name = paste0(new_col_prefix, col)
      
      if (is.null(temp_inter_df)) {
        temp_inter_df = data.frame(
          "conc" = inter_conc_vals,
          new_col_name = fitted_inter_vals
        )
      }
      else{
        temp_inter_df = cbind(temp_inter_df, new_col_name = fitted_inter_vals)
      }
    }
    df_names = colnames(df %>% select(starts_with('dAb')))
    colnames(temp_inter_df) = c('conc', df_names)
    return(temp_inter_df)
  })
  
  interpolated_dfs = lapply(names(interpolated_dfs), function(name) {
    df = interpolated_dfs[[name]]
    df = df %>% mutate(Replicate = name, .before = conc)
    return(df)
  })
  
  interpolated_df = do.call(rbind, interpolated_dfs)
  target_vector = gsub(".*_", "", interpolated_df$Replicate)
  print(interpolated_df)
  print(length(target_vector))
  interpolated_df = interpolated_df %>% mutate("target_vector" = target_vector,
                                               .before = conc)
  return(interpolated_df)
}

dab18_interpolated = interpolate_split_data(data=dab18_train,
                                            num_points = 25)
```

```{r}
# Training random forest models
rf_interpolated_modl = function(df,
                                target,
                                k1,
                                num_repeats.
                                n_points){
  performance_df = NULL
  acc_list = list()
  train_results_list = list()
  
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
      kfold_ind = groupKFold(group=df$Replicates, k=k1)
      
      for (fold in 1:k1){
        train = df[kfold_ind[[fold]],]
        test = df[-kfold_ind[[fold]],]

        model_formula = paste(target, '~', '.') %>% as.formula()
        
        train_control = trainControl(method='repeatedcv',
                                     number=5,
                                     repeats=3)
        
        # I could also include a weight matrix that places a heavier weight onto the original concentration points
        train = interpolate_split_data(train,
                                       num_points = n_points)
        
        # Select only fluorescence and target vector columns (drops conc and replicate cols)
        train = train %>% select(starts_with(c('dAb','target')))
        test = test %>% select(starts_with(c('dAb','target')))
        
        # Preprocess data
        preproc = preProcess(train, method=c('center','scale'))
        
        train = predict(preproc, train)
        test = predict(preproc, test)
        
        # x_train = train %>% select(-target)
        # y_train = train[[target]]
        # print(x_train)
        # 
        # x_test = test %>% select(-target)
        y_test = test[[target]]
        tune_grid = expand.grid(.mtry=c(2:5),
                                .splitrule='gini',
                                .min.node.size=c(1,2,3,4))
        
        trained_model = train(model_formula,
                              data=train,
                              method='ranger',
                              importance='impurity',
                              trControl=train_control,
                              metric='Kappa',
                              tuneGrid=tune_grid)
        train_results = trained_model$results
        train_results_list = c(train_results_list, train_results)
        
        opt_predict = predict(trained_model, test,
                              type='raw')
        
        opt_predict = opt_predict %>% as.factor()
        
        # Need to convert factor names to match the target vector and ensure all potential factor levels are included in the predictions, even if a certain factor level wasn't predicted
        opt_predict = recode_factor(opt_predict, BETA = "Beta",
                                    OMI = "Omicron",
                                    DELTA = "Delta",
                                    WT = "WT")
        levels(opt_predict) = c(levels(opt_predict), "Beta", "Omicron", "Delta", "WT")

        accuracy = Accuracy(opt_predict, y_test)
        acc_list = c(acc_list, accuracy)
        
        coef_imp = varImp(trained_model)
      }
  }
  return(list("Accuracy" = acc_list,
              "TrainResults" = train_results_list))
}
```

```{r}
svm_interpolated_modl = function(df,
                                target,
                                k1,
                                num_repeats){
  performance_df = NULL
  acc_list = list()
  train_results_list = list()
  
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
      kfold_ind = groupKFold(group=df$Replicates, k=k1)
      
      for (fold in 1:k1){
        train = df[kfold_ind[[fold]],]
        test = df[-kfold_ind[[fold]],]

        model_formula = paste(target, '~', '.') %>% as.formula()
        
        train_control = trainControl(method='repeatedcv',
                                     number=5,
                                     repeats=3)
        
        # I could also include a weight matrix that places a heavier weight onto the original concentration points
        train = interpolate_split_data(train,
                                       num_points = 100)
        
        # Select only fluorescence and target vector columns (drops conc and replicate cols)
        train = train %>% select(starts_with(c('dAb','target')))
        test = test %>% select(starts_with(c('dAb','target')))
        
        # Preprocess data
        preproc = preProcess(train, method=c('center','scale'))
        
        train = predict(preproc, train)
        test = predict(preproc, test)
        
        # x_train = train %>% select(-target)
        # y_train = train[[target]]
        # print(x_train)
        # 
        # x_test = test %>% select(-target)
        y_test = test[[target]]
        
        trained_model = train(model_formula,
                              data=train,
                              method='svmRadial',
                              trControl=train_control,
                              metric='Kappa',
                              tuneLength=15)
        train_results = trained_model$results
        train_results_list = c(train_results_list, train_results)
        
        opt_predict = predict(trained_model, test,
                              type='raw')
        
        opt_predict = opt_predict %>% as.factor()
        
        # Need to convert factor names to match the target vector and ensure all potential factor levels are included in the predictions, even if a certain factor level wasn't predicted
        opt_predict = recode_factor(opt_predict, BETA = "Beta",
                                    OMI = "Omicron",
                                    DELTA = "Delta",
                                    WT = "WT")
        levels(opt_predict) = c(levels(opt_predict), "Beta", "Omicron", "Delta", "WT")

        accuracy = Accuracy(opt_predict, y_test)
        acc_list = c(acc_list, accuracy)
        
      }
  }
  return(list("Accuracy" = acc_list,
              "TrainResults" = train_results_list))
}
```
